_comment: Weekly snapshots of the OPEN CommitFest, used to compute week-over-week deltas. Only the current run's week and the previous week are kept in full (the previous one is needed for the delta and to track the fate of a patch flagged a week ago); every earlier week is collapsed to {week, cf, created_n, closed_n, net} in weeks_summary. Full history lives in references/archive/commitfest-2026.json (not read at runtime).

weeks_summary.net: in-window: 4 committed, 2 withdrawn; multiple new records (UUID cluster, reorder-buffer perf, ANALYZE sampling hook, new GUC/aggregate proposals)
5 created vs 27 closed in covered span -> net -22 (queue draining as In Progress began; commit tempo ~6x last week's 4)

weeks.highlight: Net +31 (46 created / 15 closed: 14 committed, 1 withdrawn [a duplicate entry]; 0 rejected, 0 RwF) vs +20 last week; both weeks complete counts. Active PG20-3 queue 511 (366 NR / 43 WoA / 102 RfC) vs 469 (339/38/92): +27 NR, +10 RfC. 11 RfC promotions. Three filers produced 14 of the 46 new entries (6 [PG19] bug entries from one, 4 ruleutils deparse fixes from another, 4 WITHOUT OVERLAPS fixes from Paul Jungwirth). Standout: Matthias Dötsch's ExecIndexOnlyScan specialization (#7468), ~5-6.5% fewer instructions, also under LTO.
